caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the performance of different trigger words on the vertical axis, with the words represented along the horizontal axis. The x-axis is labeled "trigger words" and displays categories including "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletics" in that order. The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and spans a range from approximately 0.5 to 0.95, with tick labels at 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, and 0.9. A green solid line with a circular marker represents the "start" trigger, beginning at an ASR value of 0.6 for "cf" and concluding at 0.85 for "athletics." A red dashed line with an x marker denotes the "random" trigger, starting at 0.52 for "cf" and ending at 0.78 for "athletics." A blue solid line with a square marker indicates the "end" trigger, starting at 0.61 for "cf" and finishing at 0.88 for "athletics."
